paper.authors: Wang P, Wang J, Wang Q, Youngblood MW, et al.
paper.title: Spatial chromatin architecture and accessibility co-profiling of mammalian tissues

data_source.why_synthetic: Reproducing the paper's figures from GSE307620 requires multi-terabyte FASTQ plus read alignment, the one step `spatial-hic` deliberately does not own (Cell Ranger ATAC; runHiC is GPL-3.0 and excluded by policy). This benchmark instead plants structure that is exact by construction -- a copy-number gain confined to one spatial clone, a clone-specific loop, alternating A/B blocks, a TSS spike -- with contact statistics calibrated to fall inside the paper's reported bands, and asserts the pipeline recovers all of it. Ground truth is re-measured off the emitted files by prep_input.py and written to truth.json, so a miscalibrated generator is never charged to the skill.
data_source.geo_leg: run.sh --with-geo additionally enumerates the real GSE307620 deposits
